Stated Claim / Post Context:
Pair of fearless dogs chase massive bear into the woods

Actual Article Body:
(CNN) - A pair of fearless dogs work to keep people safe by chasing bears back into the Nevada wilderness.

Badger and Banjo, a pair of fast and fearless Karelian bear dogs, are considered specialists with the Nevada Department of Wildlife. They chase bears captured in populated areas back into the wilderness in a type of “bear hazing.”

These dogs clearly send the bears the message that they are not welcome.

It can be a dangerous duty, with video showing at least one very close call with claws.

But wildlife officials say every operation is carefully planned and executed by professionals to keep not just the people safe but the dogs and the bears as well.
